_readme: Merced College's Coursedog catalog (S411, SkySotol). The catalog sits on catalog.mccd.edu and its scripts fetch the program list and a whole-catalog PDF from app.coursedog.com, which a read kept to the page's own domain never printed (run 39077970234, S409). Hartnell's catalog fetched its PDF address from app.coursedog.com's pdf-reports/catalogs/<catalogId> call; this read keeps that host's data calls so Merced's PDF address and catalogId print, and the reader requests nothing beyond what the pages' own scripts fetch.

outside_hosts.app.coursedog.com: Merced's catalog vendor: the catalog's own scripts on catalog.mccd.edu fetch the program list and the PDF address from it; the read keeps those responses and requests nothing of its own there.

questions.pdf_address: The whole-catalog PDF's address and the catalogId the catalog's scripts fetch it by.
questions.program_codes: How the program search names each program (title, code, award), to check the PDF's Title - CODE headings against.
